_comment: MACHINE-READABLE LAB CLASSIFICATION — the single source of truth for which lab books
run in the default reproduction pipeline and which may feed the website.
Hand-maintained; guarded by tests/test_lab_manifest.py (every scripts/lab_*.py must appear
here exactly once, and the reproduce/publication consumers must agree with it).
Consumers: scripts/reproduce.sh (default lab set) and scripts/build_data.py (publication),
Why this file exists: docs/review/semantic_integrity_review.md P0 — the lab pipeline
bypassed the canonical data-integrity boundary. _results_summary.json is RETIRED (144
entries, replaced by the registry-backed canonical corpus in build_data.py), yet labs still
read it and the website still published their output. This manifest is release item 1
(quarantine): classify every lab, then remove the noncanonical ones from default

status_vocabulary.canonical: Consumes only live, non-retired result records. Runs in the default reproduction pipeline and is eligible to feed the website (subject to the s2 lineage contract).
status_vocabulary.historical: Kept for provenance and still runnable by hand (`agentic-dynamics analyze lab <name>`), but its question or corpus belongs to a superseded measurement era. Not published.
status_vocabulary.quarantined: Consumes a RETIRED or otherwise noncanonical source (directly or transitively). The file is kept (historical record) but it is NOT run by reproduce.sh and its output is NOT published. Lifting a quarantine requires re-pointing the lab at a canonical source.

field_semantics.publication_eligible: Hard gate: may this lab's output reach apps/website/data.js at all? quarantined => always false.
field_semantics.website_key: The data.js key this lab feeds, or null when the site consumes nothing from it. build_data.py loads a lab only when publication_eligible AND website_key is set.
field_semantics.reproduce_default: Is this lab in scripts/reproduce.sh's default (core) lab set? quarantined => always false.
field_semantics.output: Artifact the lab writes under experiments/results/, or null when it only prints to stdout.
field_semantics.input_sources: Every dataset the lab reads, as repo-relative paths/globs (transitive sources noted in rationale).
field_semantics.reads_retired_summary: True when experiments/results/_results_summary.json is reached directly or transitively.
field_semantics.requires_external_service: External dependency that makes the lab non-deterministic/unavailable offline (neo4j | sonarqube | opencode_inference), else null.
field_semantics.contract_status: s2 lineage contract state: 'pending' = the lab does not yet embed input_dataset_id / input_manifest_sha256 / registry_version / metric_definition_version; 'n/a' = quarantined, contract not applicable.
field_semantics.rationale: Why this classification — the evidence, not the intent.

lab_basin_topology.py.rationale: Reads the retired summary directly (scripts/lab_basin_topology.py:18) and classifies basins over the retired SEMANTIC/MANIFOLD taxonomy.

lab_basin_topology_neo4j.py.rationale: Transitively summary-derived: the ExperimentRun nodes it queries are loaded from the retired summary (src/agentic_dynamics/knowledge/graph.py:245, Neo4jClient.load_runs), and it validates against the quarantined lab_basin_topology.json. Also requires a live Neo4j, which is why reproduce.sh:56-57 (unconditional inclusion) was flagged P1.

lab_cache_economics.py.rationale: Reads only the live story corpus. Not yet contract-bearing: it globs raw story results rather than resolving through the registry (s2).

lab_claude_audit.py.rationale: Reads the retired summary directly (scripts/lab_claude_audit.py:16); the $47.54 audit is a claim about the retired corpus.

lab_condition_effects.py.rationale: Reads only the live story + review corpora. The review flagged its unfiltered raw-story globbing — a contract (s2) problem, not a retired-source problem, so it is not quarantined.

lab_grit_matrix.py.rationale: Reads the retired summary directly (scripts/lab_grit_matrix.py:15) and was the one lab published straight into data.js (build_data.py _load_grit_matrix). website_key stays recorded so build_data can LOG the rejection by name instead of silently dropping the section. Second defect, deferred to s4: it calls a correctness x escape quadrant 'high_grit', colliding with the README's formal G(s) = P(test_executed_success | perturbation_strength = s).

lab_opencode_meta_analysis.py.rationale: Transitively summary-derived via opencode_analyzer._load_summary (src/agentic_dynamics/reporting/opencode_analyzer.py:23,26). It is also a meta-EXPERIMENT: it spends real inference and is nondeterministic, so it can never belong to a deterministic core reproduction.

lab_quality_frontier.py.rationale: Reads only the live analysis + story corpora.

lab_sonar_quality.py.rationale: Reads the retired summary directly (scripts/lab_sonar_quality.py:23) and depends on its sonar_* per-cell fields, which have no canonical replacement (build_data._compute_sonar already emits an explicit [P] historical marker for exactly this reason). Prints to stdout; writes no artifact.

lab_story_arc.py.rationale: Reads only the live story corpus. Cited on the evidence page (D.labs.story_arc).

lab_story_review.py.rationale: Reads only the live story corpus via story.load_story_result. Eligible, but no site section consumes it today (website_key null), so build_data does not load it.

lab_task_routing.py.rationale: Reads the retired summary directly (scripts/lab_task_routing.py:15). Note: the website's routing section does NOT come from this lab — build_data derives it from agentic_dynamics.control.routing.compute_routing over the canonical corpus, so quarantining this lab does not remove a published section.

lab_verification_frontier.py.rationale: Reads only the live story corpus.

lab_verification_value.py.rationale: Reads only the live story + review corpora.
